queries.name: silver.contrat.aggregation[0]
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-14' AND (date_debut IS NULL OR date_fin IS NULL OR date_fin <= date_debut) THEN 1 END),
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (duree_garantie_mois IS NULL) AND NOT (duree_garantie_mois IN (12,24,36,60)) THEN 1 END) 
FROM contrat

queries.name: silver.contrat.contrat_id.duplicate_count
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM contrat
    WHERE contrat_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY contrat_id)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frequencies
WHERE frequency > 1

queries.name: silver.contrat.contrat_id.duplicate_count.failing_sql
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT contrat_id
    FROM contrat
    WHERE contrat_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY contrat_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT main.*
FROM contrat main
JOIN frequencies ON main.contrat_id = frequencies.contrat_id
